description.value:
Area 5-foot emanation

Duration constant

Saving Throw Fortitude vs. your class DC

The air near you tastes like a sickroom. A creature that ends its turn in the emanation must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or become sickened 1. A creature that has already attempted this save cannot be forced to attempt it again for 1 minute, whether it succeeded or failed. You and your Afflicted are unaffected.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Aura rule element's schema (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/aura.ts:41-80) technically supports a per-effect turn-end event with a save sub-object, which would fit a "creature ending its turn in an aura attempts a save" clause. But an exhaustive search of every shipped item using Aura with save populated (grep -rl "\"key\": \"Aura\"" pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/ | xargs grep -l "\"save\"") turns up only files where "save" appears elsewhere in the same actor document (system.saves), never inside the Aura rule element itself -- confirmed by reading chafkhem.json's "Despair" and dread-dhuthorex.json's "Frightful Presence", both of which use only radius/slug/traits or an effects[].uuid grant on "enter", never the save sub-field. The schema field exists but is unused anywhere in the shipped compendium, so this is not authored blind against an unprecedented schema corner.
